I arbeidet med musikkteori, improvisasjo: As I study music theory, improvisation and composition, the same questions keep coming up: Why does this chord connection work? What gives a mode its character? How can what I understand on paper become something I actually hear and use?

Derfor kombinerer MODUS backingtracks, t: That is why MODUS combines backing tracks, theory articles, audio examples and maps for guitar and piano. You can read about an idea, listen to it and take it to your instrument without starting over each time.
Et viktig utgangspunkt for meg er å se f: An important starting point for me is seeing the connections in music. You do not necessarily need a new scale map every time the chord changes. Often you can keep the same notes and explore which ones take on new roles against the harmony.
Det betyr ikke at alle toner virker likt: This does not mean every note works the same way over every chord. It means the map can stay clear while your listening and musical choices become more precise.

MODUS er ikke et ferdig svar på hvordan: MODUS is not a final answer to how music should be learned. It is a project that grows through my own studies, questions and practical experiments. The aim is to make music theory more accessible and useful without losing its nuances.
Naturpreget på siden er også et bevisst: The nature-inspired appearance is a deliberate choice too. For me, nature and music are connected as sources of attention and inspiration. The visuals should leave room to focus on the sound, the ideas and the playing.

Når du spiller fire toner samtidig, kan: When you play four notes together, you can think of them as four voices. Each voice can continue to a new note in the next chord. A progression can therefore be heard as several small melodic lines.
Stemmeføring handler om denne videreføri: Voice leading is about this continuation. It is not just about which chord symbol comes next, but how the individual notes get there.
Cmaj7 inneholder C, E, G og B. Am7 inneh: Cmaj7 contains C, E, G and B. Am7 contains A, C, E and G. Three notes are shared: C, E and G.
En mulig overgang på piano er C–E–G–B ti: One possible piano transition is C–E–G–B to C–E–G–A. The three lower voices stay while B moves down a whole tone to A. The final chord is Am7 with C in the bass, or first inversion.
Small movements can bring calm and continuity. Larger leaps, a change of register or a new bass note may be right when you want contrast and direction. Good voice leading does not mean every voice must always move as little as possible.
På gitaren påvirker grepenes oppbygning: On guitar, the construction of the shapes affects what is practical. A shape may double notes or omit a perfect fifth. Consider both the voices you actually play and the musical role you want to highlight.
Prøv å holde øverste tone som en tydelig: Try treating the highest voice as a clear melodic line. It can give your chord playing its own story even when the rest of the harmony is simple.

Start med E, G og B. Dette er treklangst: Start with E, G and B. These are the triad notes of E minor. Play one or two notes at a time and let the backing track answer in the gaps. You are practising making a phrase, not showing that you know a scale.
Finn en rytme du liker på én tone. Gjent: Find a rhythm you like on one note. Repeat the rhythm and change only the last note. Then try the same notes with a different rhythm. This creates a clear connection between phrases.
Du kan også svare på en kort frase med e: You can also answer a short phrase with a similar phrase. Listen for whether the answer feels like a continuation, a question or an ending. The pause between them is part of the music.
Alle sju tonene kan høre til tonearten,: All seven notes may belong to the key, but their meaning changes against the chords being played. A note that feels settled over Em7 may create more tension over another chord.
Etter hvert kan du undersøke akkordtonen: Over time, explore the chord tones of each chord and land on one when the harmony changes. You do not need to move the whole scale map with every change: listen for new target notes within the same map.
Sett tempoet rolig. Bruk E, G og B i én: Set a relaxed tempo. Use E, G and B for one round. Then add D, followed by F♯. Play fewer notes if you stop hearing what the phrase is trying to say.

En septimakkord har i grunnformen fire f: A seventh chord has four different notes in its basic form: root, third, fifth and seventh. Notes can be doubled or moved to other octaves without changing the chord type.
Spør først: Er tersen stor eller liten?: First ask: Is the third major or minor? Then ask: Is the seventh major or minor? Cmaj7 and C7 both have a major third but different sevenths. Cm7 and Cm(maj7) both have a minor third but different sevenths.
I Cm(maj7) betyr «maj7» at septimen er s: In Cm(maj7), “maj7” means the seventh is major. It does not mean the triad is major. The brackets make this combination easier to read.
Behold C, E og G, og bytt mellom B og B♭: Keep C, E and G and alternate between B and B♭. You move between Cmaj7 and C7 with only one note. Then keep C, E♭ and G and do the same: now you are comparing Cm(maj7) and Cm7.
Navnet dominantseptim beskriver akkordty: The term dominant seventh describes a chord type with a major third and a minor seventh. Whether it actually functions as a dominant depends on the context. In blues and modal music it can have other roles too.
Velg Cmaj7 og C7 i akkordverkstedet. Se: Choose Cmaj7 and C7 in the chord workshop. See which key moves. Repeat with Cm7 and Cm(maj7), then try a piano inversion that keeps the remaining notes close together.

A naturlig moll består av A, B, C, D, E,: A natural minor contains A, B, C, D, E, F and G. Raise G to G♯ and you get A harmonic minor:
Formelen er 1–2–♭3–4–5–♭6–7. G♯ ligger e: The formula is 1–2–♭3–4–5–♭6–7. G♯ is a semitone below A and can act as a leading note. It also lets the chord on the fifth degree have a major third: E–G♯–B, or E7 when D is added.
Med E som sentrum gir det samme tonemate: With E as the centre, the same notes give E Phrygian dominant:
Den lille sekunden F ligger tett på E, s: The minor second F sits close to E, while G♯ provides a major third. This combination of ♭2 and 3 distinguishes the sound from ordinary Phrygian, which has a minor third.
E7 can act as the dominant of A minor. E Phrygian dominant can then offer a scale colour over the dominant before the music returns home to A.
Hvis E i stedet holdes som musikalsk sen: If E is instead sustained as the musical centre, you can explore the same notes modally. The harmonic experience is not automatically the same, even though the notes match.
Mellom F og G♯ ligger en forstørret seku: F to G♯ is an augmented second: three semitones. Use the leap deliberately and also try phrases that connect it through the root E or the fourth A.
Spill E–F–E og deretter E–G♯–E over en E: Play E–F–E and then E–G♯–E over an E drone. Combine the two ideas. Compare with ordinary E Phrygian by replacing G♯ with G.

En tone er et utgangspunkt: One note is a starting point
Spill en E. Spill deretter en annen tone: Play E. Then play another note. What you hear between them is an interval. It may feel narrow or wide, settled or tense. The experience depends on timbre, register and musical context.
På gitaren er ett bånd et halvt trinn. P: On guitar, one fret is a semitone. On piano, a semitone is the distance to the nearest key, whether white or black. E to F and B to C are semitones even though both keys are white.
MODUS bruker internasjonale tonenavn: B: MODUS uses international note names: B is often called H in Norwegian notation, while B♭ corresponds to Norwegian B.
To halve trinn gir ett helt trinn. Fra C: Two semitones make a whole tone. C to D is two semitones. C to E is four semitones: a major third. C to E♭ is three semitones: a minor third.
Antall halvtoner er et nyttig kart. Boks: Counting semitones provides a useful map. Letter names also help determine the interval name: C–F♯ is an augmented fourth, while C–G♭ is a diminished fifth. They can sound the same on a standard piano but are written and understood differently.
Spill først tonene etter hverandre. Da h: First play the notes in succession. You hear the interval as a melodic movement. Then play them together to hear it as a harmony.
Begynn med bare to intervaller, for ekse: Start with just two intervals, such as minor and major thirds. Compare them from the same root. The aim is to recognise a difference you can use, rather than collect as many names as possible at once.
Spill C–E og C–E♭ rolig, først etter hve: Play C–E and C–E♭ slowly, first in succession and then together. Sing the upper note before playing it. Repeat from D and E.

Sett C øverst. Gå én ren kvint opp, så f: Put C at the top. Go up a perfect fifth to G. Another fifth gives D, followed by A, E and B. Continue around the full circle and you return to the pitch class C.
En ren kvint er sju halvtoner, for eksem: A perfect fifth is seven semitones, for example C–G. In the other direction you follow descending fifths, or ascending fourths: C–F–B♭–E♭. The octave you play in may change; we are mapping relationships between pitch classes.
MODUS bruker internasjonale tonenavn: B: MODUS uses international note names: B corresponds to Norwegian H, while B♭ corresponds to Norwegian B. The illustration places major keys outside and relative minor keys inside.
Fra C-dur, som ikke har faste fortegn, g: Starting from C major, which has no sharps or flats in its key signature, each clockwise step adds one sharp. G major has F♯. D major has F♯ and C♯. Going anticlockwise adds one flat: F major has B♭, and B♭ major has B♭ and E♭.
Nabotonearter på sirkelen har seks av sj: Neighbouring keys on the circle share six of seven scale notes. C major and G major, for example, differ only in F and F♯. They sit close on the map even though their tonics are a fifth apart.
Nederst møter du F♯-dur og G♭-dur. På et: At the bottom you meet F♯ major and G♭ major. On a standard equal-tempered piano they use the same keys, but the notes are spelled differently: F♯ major has six sharps, G♭ major six flats. The circle shows common spellings; keys such as C♯ major with seven sharps also exist.

Behold pulsen når aksentene flytter seg: Keep the pulse when the accents move
Tell sju jevne åttendedeler. I 2+2+3 leg: Count seven even eighth notes. In 2+2+3, the group starts are at positions 1, 3 and 5. In 3+2+2, they are at 1, 4 and 6. Clap only these positions while continuing to feel all seven eighth notes.
Bytt gruppering etter fire takter og beh: Switch grouping after four bars while keeping the same tempo. If you speed up in the group of three, return to counting without the instrument before adding notes again.

Begynn med tonene, ikke med grepene: Start with the notes, not the shapes
G major consists of G, A, B, C, D, E and F♯. Choose G as the root and take alternate scale notes: G–B–D. This produces a G major triad. Start on A and do the same: A–C–E. This time you get A minor.
Avstanden mellom tonene avgjør akkordtyp: The distances between the notes determine the chord quality. G–B is a major third, while A–C is a minor third. That is why the chords are not all major, even though you are using a major scale.
De sju treklangene i G-dur: The seven triads in G major
Fortsett fra hvert skalatrinn og bruk ba: Continue from each scale degree using only notes from G major. After F♯, continue with G in the next octave. The chords are G, Am, Bm, C, D, Em and F♯dim.
Tonene er G–B–D, A–C–E, B–D–F♯, C–E–G, D: The notes are G–B–D, A–C–E, B–D–F♯, C–E–G, D–F♯–A, E–G–B and F♯–A–C. The final triad is diminished: above F♯ it has a minor third, A, and a diminished fifth, C.
I G-dur blir akkordrekken I–ii–iii–IV–V–: In G major, the sequence is I–ii–iii–IV–V–vi–vii°. Uppercase numerals indicate major, lowercase indicate minor, and the small circle indicates a diminished triad. This pattern applies to diatonic triads in every major key.
Prøv I–V–vi–IV: G–D–Em–C. Flytter du sam: Try I–V–vi–IV: G–D–Em–C. Move the same degree pattern to C major and it becomes C–G–Am–F. The notes and shapes change, while the relationship between the degrees remains.
Samme toner kan få et annet hjem: The same notes can have a different home
E naturlig moll bruker de samme tonene s: E natural minor uses the same notes as G major. Yet Em is the first degree when E is the centre, and the sixth degree in G major. Choose the reference key before assigning Roman numerals to a progression.
Diatonisk betyr her at akkordtonene komm: Diatonic here means that the chord tones come from the selected scale. Music can also use chords outside this family. First learn to recognise the pattern; later departures will then be easier to understand.
Bygg akkordene i en toneart: Build the chords in a key
Når du bygger treklanger av skalatonene,: Building triads from scale notes gives you a family of chords. G major shows how notes, chord names and Roman numerals connect.
Skriv tonene i G, Am og D før du spiller: Write the notes of G, Am and D before playing them. Then play G–D–Em–C and say I–V–vi–IV. Move the same pattern to C major and check which notes change.
Bygg en akkordrekke i verkstedet: Build a progression in the workshop
Bruk Em–C–G–D som eksempel. Alle fire tr: Use Em–C–G–D as an example. All four triads can be built from E, F♯, G, A, B, C and D. This is the note collection of E natural minor and G major.
Finn tonene i et område på gitarhalsen d: Find the notes in a fretboard area you already know, or on piano. Keep that area throughout the progression. You do not need to switch to a new physical scale pattern for each chord.
Akkordtonene er E–G–B i Em, C–E–G i C, G: The chord tones are E–G–B in Em, C–E–G in C, G–B–D in G and D–F♯–A in D. They all lie within the same pattern. What changes is which notes serve as the root, third and fifth of the current chord.
G er liten ters i Em, ren kvint i C og g: G is the minor third of Em, the perfect fifth of C and the root of G. Over D, G is a fourth above the root and is not part of the D major triad. The same note can therefore have a different effect when the chord changes.
Velg én måltone per akkord: Choose one target note per chord
Begynn med grunntonene E–C–G–D. Spill én: Start with the roots E–C–G–D. Play one note at each chord change. Then try the thirds G–E–B–F♯. Both lines follow the harmony without requiring a new scale for each change.
Når måltonene sitter, legg til en eller: Once the target notes feel secure, add one or two scale notes on the way to them. Notes outside the chord can act as passing notes, colour or tension. Their duration, rhythm and subsequent movement affect how they sound.
Ett kart er et utgangspunkt, ikke en reg: One pattern is a starting point, not a rule
Metoden fungerer her fordi akkordene del: The method works here because the chords share a diatonic note collection. If the progression introduces a note outside the scale, listen to and examine the new relationship. One fixed pattern will not necessarily fit every part of every piece.
Poenget er å knytte et kjent kart til ha: The point is to connect a familiar pattern to the harmony. Later you can extend the range or explore other colours. Let that be a musical choice, rather than an automatic requirement to use four different patterns over four chords.
Ett skalakart, nye måltoner: One scale pattern, new target notes
Du kan beholde ett kjent skalakart gjenn: You can keep one familiar scale pattern through a progression while still following the harmony. The key is to see which notes in the pattern belong to the current chord.
Spill Em–C–G–D langsomt. Bruk først bare: Play Em–C–G–D slowly. First use only E–C–G–D as targets, then G–E–B–F♯. Finally make a short phrase that lands on a chosen chord tone at each change.
E eolisk, eller E naturlig moll, har E–F: E Aeolian, or E natural minor, has E–F♯–G–A–B–C–D. E Dorian has E–F♯–G–A–B–C♯–D. Six of the seven notes are shared. The difference is the minor sixth, C, versus the major sixth, C♯, measured from E.
Begge har liten ters G og liten septim D: Both have a minor third, G, and a minor seventh, D. Dorian therefore retains a minor character even though its sixth is major. This comparison concerns the interval structure, not a fixed rule for how the music must feel.
Endre én tone i en kort frase: Change one note in a short phrase
Spill E–G–B–C–B–G–E rolig over en E-dron: Play E–G–B–C–B–G–E slowly over an E drone. Then replace only C with C♯. Keep the rhythm, register and duration as similar as possible so you are examining the pitch change rather than several changes at once.
Prøv deretter å holde C eller C♯ litt le: Then try sustaining C or C♯ a little longer before moving to B. Notice that C is a half step above B, while C♯ is a whole step above B. Describe the difference you hear without searching for one mandatory emotion word.
La akkordene støtte sammenligningen: Let the chords support the comparison
Em–Am kan støtte E eolisk når Em oppleve: Em–Am can support E Aeolian when Em feels like home. Am contains A–C–E. Replace Am with A major and C becomes C♯: A–C♯–E. Em–A can therefore support E Dorian.
Dette er i–iv mot i–IV med E som referan: With E as the reference, this is i–iv versus i–IV. The lowercase or uppercase numeral describes the chord quality. A progression alone does not guarantee how the centre is heard; use the bass, phrasing and return to Em to establish E clearly.
E eolisk og E dorisk sammenlignes parall: E Aeolian and E Dorian are compared in parallel: the same tonic, with one changed scale degree. G major and E Aeolian are relative: the same notes, with different centres. The two comparisons answer different questions.
Flytt til slutt forsøket til A. A eolisk: Finally move the experiment to A. A Aeolian has F, while A Dorian has F♯. Keep the other notes A, B, C, D, E and G. You are applying the same interval idea from a new tonic.
Dorisk og eolisk: samme grunntone, ny fa: Dorian and Aeolian: same tonic, new colour
Behold E som hjem og sammenlign C med C♯: Keep E as home and compare C with C♯. Changing just one scale degree makes the difference between Aeolian and Dorian easier to explore with both your ear and your instrument.
Spill den samme korte frasen i E eolisk: Play the same short phrase in E Aeolian and E Dorian. Explain the difference as ♭6 versus 6. Then compare Em–Am with Em–A, and repeat from A as the tonic.
Utforsk dorisk med lytting og spilling: Explore Dorian through listening and playing
1. Hvilke toner danner akkorden på andre: 1. Which notes form the chord on the second degree of G major?
Annenhver skalatone fra A gir A–C–E: A-m: Alternate scale notes from A give A–C–E: A minor, or ii in G major.
2. Hvilken treklang ligger på sjuende tr: 2. Which triad is on the seventh degree of G major?
F♯–A–C har liten ters og forminsket kvin: F♯–A–C has a minor third and diminished fifth, so the chord is diminished.
3. Hvilket trinn er Em når referansetone: 3. Which degree is Em when the reference key is G major?
E is the sixth degree above G and Em is minor. With E as the centre, the analysis changes.
1. Hvorfor kan ett toneutvalg brukes ove: 1. Why can one note collection be used over Em–C–G–D in this example?
Akkordene deler skalaens toneutvalg, men: The chords share a scale collection, but each chord has its own root, third and fifth.
Alle akkorder har de samme tre tonene: All the chords have the same three notes
Akkordene kan bygges fra samme diatonisk: The chords can be built from the same diatonic note collection
Alle skalatoner er akkordtoner over hver: Every scale note is a chord tone over every chord
2. Hvilken linje følger tersene i Em–C–G: 2. Which line follows the thirds of Em–C–G–D?
Tersene er G i Em, E i C, B i G og F♯ i: The thirds are G in Em, E in C, B in G and F♯ in D.
3. Hva bør du undersøke hvis en ny akkor: 3. What should you examine if a new chord contains a note outside the pattern?
Et felles kart er nyttig for dette diato: A shared pattern is useful for this diatonic example. Other chords may call for different note choices.
Den nye harmoniske sammenhengen og tonev: The new harmonic relationship and choice of notes
Bare hvilket bånd du begynner på: Only the fret you start on
Ingenting, fordi ett kart alltid passer: Nothing, because one pattern always fits
1. Hvilken tone endres fra E eolisk til: 1. Which note changes from E Aeolian to E Dorian?
Den lille seksten C blir den store sekst: The minor sixth, C, becomes the major sixth, C♯. E remains the tonic.
2. Hva skiller Am fra A-dur i de to vamp: 2. What distinguishes Am from A major in the two vamps?
Am har A–C–E. A-dur har A–C♯–E. Den samm: Am has A–C–E. A major has A–C♯–E. The same C/C♯ difference supports the comparison from E.
3. Hva er en parallell sammenligning her: 3. What is a parallel comparison here?
En parallell sammenligning beholder grun: A parallel comparison keeps the tonic. Here E is shared while the sixth degree changes.
G-durtreklanger bygget fra G-durskalaen:: G major scale triads: G, Am, Bm, C, D, Em and F♯dim.
Akkordtonene i Em, C, G og D ligger i et: The chord tones of Em, C, G and D lie within one shared note collection.
E eolisk og E dorisk sammenlignet med C: E Aeolian and E Dorian compared, highlighting C and C♯.

Romertall viser trinn fra grunntonen, me: Roman numerals show degrees from the tonic, using major-scale degrees as the reference. Lowercase means minor. ♭ and ♯ indicate lowered and raised degrees.
